snippet.title: Mutants: Genesis - Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Mutants: Genesis is a free-to-play online card game that is playable via PvP with up to 3 players or in single-player with PvE. Join the next generation of Psycogs and climb the ranks to establish yourself as Champion! Collect hundreds of mutants, fashion your own deck with 200 cards to choose from, and choose from 6 different genres to play. Mutants: Genesis will launch in PC Early Access in Q2 2023 with a demo available now as part of Steam Next Fest.
